decisions.name: Lefkosia (Nicosia)
decisions.reason: The original WUP 2025 row explicitly names Lefkosia (Nicosia), Cyprus, and the prior capital roster names Nicosia, Cyprus with a locator 2.16 km from the WUP point. The earlier Cyprus DLS investigation explicitly queried a Nicosia city-area envelope and retained the original first-party ArcGIS parcel response containing three polygons there with native SBPI_ID_NO values. This is a prior investigation of the same city, so WUP434 is a confirmed prior attempt and stays excluded from the pending research queue. The WUP rank, point and 333008-person population remain unchanged. The bounded response does not prove citywide coverage or qualify a live adapter.
